column3: “suffer for” renders “bear,” “your unfaithfulness” renders “your harlotries (zenut),” and “lie in the wilderness” renders “are finished in the wilderness.”
“your guilt” renders “your iniquities,” and “My opposition” renders a rare word (tenu’ah) whose meaning is uncertain.
“surely” renders the oath formula “if not,” and “be destroyed” renders “come to an end.”
“the very bad report” renders “the evil report.”
“the ridge” renders “the top” (also in verse 44), and “promised” renders “said”; NASB reorders “for we have sinned” as “we have indeed sinned, but.”
“the commandment of the LORD” renders “the mouth of the LORD.”
“went up heedlessly” renders a rare verb (ya’pilu), perhaps “presumed”; the meaning is uncertain.
